_about: English's own overflows on Overview and Limits, as English drew them at c05f45d, as tests/browser/page_probe.js measured them in headless Chromium at a device pixel ratio of 1, with the dev server's clock and the page's held at 2026-10-21 16:12 UTC, in every scenario and routed state of its widths step (states) and window size (sizes, outer). Each names its look(s), page, element (at, as page_checks.js's measure() writes its path), kind (wide: scrollWidth - clientWidth, or for a cut under a px how far its words run past its content box, to 0.1 px; leaves-side: px past its card) and how far it runs past its box in English (by). Two cuts under a px, Edgerun's efficiency subtitle and Night City's model-mix subtitle at 1060 x 640, were added by #98's second review, whose measure sees them (the whole-px one did not); every other entry is as first measured. why: heading (Night City's page heading, whose slanted cursor runs 3 px past its box; nothing is cut), ellipsis (an Overview card's subtitle that the theme's own rule cuts with an ellipsis; since #98 its whole text is in its title), find (not by design: at 1060 x 640 Nostromo's weekly and scoped Overview cards cut their reset line, countdown and chip). owner: the decision that keeps it, as Chris made them on #98 (Q3 on 2026-11-26, then all of them looked at one by one on 2026-11-27): Night City's headings "decided, kept (Chris 2026-11-26)"; every ellipsis, Edgerun's in the default window too, "kept until #118 (approved 2026-11-27) moves the subtitle under the title"; the six find entries "kept until #117". Until #117 and #118 land the record keeps them, so English does not change here. In English a known one may run at most 1 px further; anything else fails, and another language has none.
